brewery.brewery_description: Sunshine Brewery is an independently owned Microbrewery established in Maroochydore in the Sunshine State of Queensland in 2017. Making fresh ales on a 6Hl Brewhouse with all brewing operations open to view from the cellar door tasting bar

beer.beer_name: Kveik Or The Dead Hazy IPA
Island Sunrise Juicy Pale - Aka Summer Session
Kveik Or The Dead Hazy IPA

beer.beer_description: Like its parent – Double Sunshine IPA, this is a strong hop-forward beer with aromas of sweet grapefruit and passionfruit layered on a strong malty backbone. Best served in a large goblet glass.  Available in cans.
A German wheat beer, light and refreshing with the classic ester aromas of banana and cloves and a spritzy finish.
A strong hop forward beer with aromas of sweet grapefruit and passionfruit layered on a strong malty backbone
Pronounced aroma of tropical fruits, pineapple and a slight pine resin, and still a very pale ale with a nice white lacey head.  Available in draught and cans.

beer.beer_name: Kveik Or The Dead Hazy IPA
beer.beer_description: OK, It’s official the brewer has gone crazy!  No bittering hops and a 3-hour whirlpool???  and  then that crazy Norwegian Kveik (Quick) yeast and loads MORE HOPS.  The result is an incredibly juicy, hazy NEIPA, full of flavour and taste ….  well it tastes like full crushed pineapple juice.

We have attempted to replicate Gose by adding salt to the brewing water; souring over an extended period in the kettle with unmilled grain; adding coriander and Kaffir lime to the kettle and using a neutral yeast.  The result is a beer that smells like a margarita cocktail - slightly salty, definitely sour with a soft wheat malt finish
Rich red ale with aromas of chocolate cola, rich berry and stone fruits and a dry finish
Inspired by early mornings astride a surfboard off Mudjimba, watch sunrise over Old Woman Island, this light golden ale features aromas of tropical fruits, pineapple and pine resin.
A light easy drinking session ale, featuring soft malt finish and Nelson Sauvin hops from New Zealand

Named after the beautiful woman of Hawaiian history, who kicked arse as a surf-rider. Kelea is said to have beaten the chiefs with her grace, daring and skill on a surf board. This Australian-Style Pale Ale aims to do the same.

This liquid gold pale ale features gooseberry and citrus notes on a soft sweet malt finish.  At 4.8%, it is an easy drinking Pale Ale with enough hops to give the beer character and malt to balance it perfectly.  Available in 375ml cans and draught.
East drinking Lager-like Summer Ale featuring Enigma Hops
Loads of Saaz hops added as bittering, aroma and whirlpool additions.  The result is a crisp, dry sessionable beer, with aromas typical of a lager followed by a mild bready malt flavour.
A fruity extra pale ale made with seven different hops and Voss Kveik ale yeast

Described as “cake in a glass”, this Porter is big on flavour and creamy mouthfeel while being light on alcohol. Early on you get the aroma and taste of raspberries followed by the rich chocolate hints from organic cacao.
Saluting it's origins as a French Farmhouse Ale, this beer exhibits classic European characters, a large white foamy head and excellent flavour, accentuating the orange peel
With El Dorado hops

A dark black beer with a thick coffee-coloured head. Early aroma of coffee, giving way to a very rich chocolate flavour with a burst of orange on the end. Features local spray-free oranges and organic cacao.
Rich and dark porter infused with Styrian Fox hops from Slovenia

A small Batch brew inspired by Katie (Skater) who likes her beers big and full of hops. Katie teamed up with Davy to design and brew this one. They have loaded it with Columbus, Cascade, Mosaic, Simcoe and Citra hops. The result is a resinous pine and fruit aroma and an almost sweet fruit flavour, which masks the perceived bitterness. It drinks far too easy for the ABV
Light, hoppy pale ale to honour women in brewing using 100% Pink Boots 2020 blend hops.

Reflects all the characteristics of the Manuka Smoked Malt, which forms the base of this beer and lends to the aroma and flavour reminiscent of a fine Islay Whisky. Islay (pronounced Eye-la) is in the south of Scotland and is home of the famous peat smoky whiskies such as Laphroaig.
This Version of the Pale India Ale features Mosaic as the Aroma hop.
An easy drinking Pale Ale with enough hops to give the beer character and malt to balance it perfectly.  This single-hop Pale features Citra hops from USA.

Developed to showcase a very new hop – “Superdelic”.  This beer features Lager Light Malt from the Canterbury Plains of New Zealand and the new Kiwi hop – Superdelic. It is very light in colour and exhibits aromas of candy and some say bubblegum from the hops.

user.bio: Meeting folks from all over that enjoy different beers makes the world a little smaller. Cheers!

items.badge_description:
Hoppy Hazy IPA Day! 

For the uninitiated, Sierra Nevada had the brilliant idea to create a day of celebration for hazies back in 2023! This year, we’re excited to introduce our third iteration of the Hazy IPA Day badge. 

Whether you call it hazy, murky, blurry, or New England style, let’s raise our glasses to these heavenly hoppy ales!

items.badge_description: Hoppy International Beer Day! Beer is the common thread that connects us worldwide, bringing people together in a unique way. And beer has played a significant role in shaping countless of our most cherished memories. If there is one thing we've learned along the way: Beer is best when shared with others. Join us in recognizing remarkable breweries worldwide by unlocking the fresh 2026 International Beer Day Badge. And don't forget to follow us on Instagram @untappd so that you never miss the next badge drop!
